== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Lucky Shot (Japanese)|Lucky Shot]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157878139/UDaRs5U9FUO5tEzafc-PTQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 91317477.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0c65d3b7bbf8b5c243e46f6606b0370c6c6d3c882b35f4af32b243702beca3eb</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
